question: Which of the following books has been written by Munshi Premchand?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Nirmala.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Soz-e-Watan** was his first collection of five short stories in the book. **Godaan, Karmabhoomi, Gaban, Mansarovar, Nirmala** are some of his Novels.
 
• His real name was** Dhanpat Rai Shrivastav.**
 
• He is referred to as** 'Upanyas Samrat'.​**
